name: io.github.egoushka/chargehand
title: chargehand
description: Runs coding-agent workers on a codebase question; every claim in the answer carries evidence.

environmentVariables.name: CHARGEHAND_RUNTIME
environmentVariables.description: Worker runtime, when both or neither of claude and opencode are on PATH.

environmentVariables.name: CHARGEHAND_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: A profile/v1 file for budgets, prices, memory or a pinned runtime version.

environmentVariables.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Claude Code subscription token from claude setup-token. Set this or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Anthropic API key for Claude Code workers. Set this or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.
